name: How long does it take to install a new water filter faucet?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a new water filter faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most water filter faucet installations can be completed within 1 to 3 hours, assuming no significant plumbing modifications are required. The exact time can vary depending on the complexity of your current plumbing, the type of filter system, and whether a new hole needs to be drilled in your countertop. Having adequate space under the sink and easily accessible shut-off valves can expedite the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes 1 to 3 hours, varying based on plumbing complexity and whether a new hole needs to be drilled.
